before.requirement: Reach the newly specified destructor cleanup after a reported parse error with a pending last_comment.
before.reason: The before destructor has no last_comment cleanup, so this frozen cleanup capability did not yet exist.

after.requirement: Call ucl_parser_free after a reported parse error while parser->last_comment is pending, allowing its new cleanup to release the comment.
after.reason: The cleanup exists and the harness would skip it on a reported error. Comment creation, retention through an error, and feasibility with flags 0 remain unproved.

claims.reason: The before destructor lacks the frozen cleanup capability. The after destructor has it, but the required pending-comment error state under the old harness is not established.
missing_information: Both versions of src/ucl_parser.c::ucl_skip_comments and src/ucl_parser.c::ucl_attach_comment, including every assignment or release of parser->last_comment.

Both versions of the path from src/ucl_parser.c::ucl_parser_add_chunk_priority through ucl_parser_add_chunk_full and ucl_state_machine to a reported error, to determine whether last_comment can remain pending with parser flags 0.
The comment-staging and parse-error paths are needed to establish whether a finite input can satisfy the frozen condition with ucl_parser_new(0).
